jei.simplefun.head_source: Only a charged creeper explosion killing the animal drops this head. One head per creeper. No crafting recipe. Wear it, place on a floor/wall, or put it above a note block.
jei.simplefun.brick_snowball: Four snowballs around a brick. Throw with use; the server enforces damage and cooldown caps.
simplefun.guide.page.1.title: Simple Fun
simplefun.guide.page.1: Bounded playful mechanics, throwable bricks, cosmetic transformations and farm-animal heads.
simplefun.guide.page.2.title: Sneak Throw
simplefun.guide.page.2: Sneak while dropping items. Server multiplier 0.1–3, velocity capped at 1.5 blocks/tick, pickup delay 20 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.3.title: Throwable Bricks
simplefun.guide.page.3: Brick, nether brick and resin brick: throw with use. Server cooldown 10 ticks, lifetime 200 ticks, damage 0–4. Glass breaking defaults off.
simplefun.guide.page.4.title: Piggy Transformation
simplefun.guide.page.4: Eating raw or cooked pork grants a cosmetic pig head for five minutes; milk removes the effect.
simplefun.guide.page.5.title: Damageless
simplefun.guide.page.5: Feather melee and Damageless I deal zero direct melee damage, with knockback. Novice librarians offer the book for 25 emeralds, three uses. Switches control effect and trades.
simplefun.guide.page.6.title: Knockback V
simplefun.guide.page.6: Vanilla Knockback accepts feathers/sticks and levels up to five; this replaces vanilla enchantment data and can collide with datapacks.
simplefun.guide.page.7.title: Player Heads
simplefun.guide.page.7: PvP death drops the victim’s vanilla player head with skin; server switch.
simplefun.guide.page.8.title: Admin Commands
simplefun.guide.page.8: Permission level 4: /simplefun pvp headDrops; /simplefun tweaks yeet toggle/strength; /simplefun tweaks bricks enable/breakGlass/damage/snowballDamage. Values are bounded server-side.
simplefun.guide.page.9.title: Brick Snowball
simplefun.guide.page.9: Four snowballs around one brick craft one. Stack 16. Separate switch; damage 0–4, throw cooldown 10 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.10.title: Pig Head
simplefun.guide.page.10: Only a charged creeper killing this animal drops its head; at most one head per creeper. No recipe. Place on floor/wall,
simplefun.guide.page.11.title: Pig Head
simplefun.guide.page.11: wear, or put above a note block. Sneaking while wearing it gives a quiet cosmetic greeting, at most every five seconds.

simplefun.guide.page.18.title: Flower Sniff
simplefun.guide.page.18: Cosmetic delight: hold a flower and sneak. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds, shared with head greetings. No gameplay rewards.

simplefun.guide.page.23.title: Honey Bubbles

simplefun.guide.page.24.title: Bread Crumbs

simplefun.guide.page.25.title: Berry Blush
simplefun.guide.page.25: Cosmetic delight: eat sweet or glow berries. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds, shared with head greetings. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.26.title: Server Configuration
simplefun.guide.page.26: Three tabs cover gameplay, heads and small delights; every option explains its default. Gameplay uses only server settings.
simplefun.guide.page.27.title: Animal head abilities
simplefun.guide.page.27: Worn animal heads can do something small and fun: the cow head lets other players milk you, the sheep head lets them shear you, the chicken head lays eggs, the pig head digs things up.
simplefun.guide.page.28.title: Settings
simplefun.guide.page.28: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
